text:
emma_finance: Quick escalation: Invoice 68102 (AcmeHealth private) shows a migration overage charge and a separate PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ credit. Procurement wants clarity.

raj_sales: Which invoice lines?

emma_finance: Lines: Private license $120k, Platform fee $30k, Support prorate $4.5k, Usage overage $7.2k, PLATFORM-BURST-ADJ -$6k. Net they pay +$1.2k unexpectedly.

marta_revops: Ops shows a scaling event during their bulk import (ops-bot event). Looks like sales had approved a partial concession verbally. No formal credit memo existed.

ops-bot: Notice: dedicated pool scaled to 118% for 3h15m on 2025-10-03. job-id=import-acme-20251003.

support_agent: Customer message: "We were billed for an onboarding spike caused by Redwood tooling. Request reversal."

emma_finance: I don't want to set full-credit precedent. Suggest 70% credit of overage ($5,040) contingent on signed PO amendment acknowledging split responsibility.

raj_sales: I can secure the PO addendum. Ask Acme to sign confirming the import was part of onboarding and they accept partial responsibility. ETA 48h.

lex_billing: After signed amendment and RevOps attaches logs, billing will issue credit memo $5,040. Use GL 4202 and description: "Onboarding migration overage concession, 70% approved". Will link to invoice 68102.

marta_revops: I'll attach ops logs and support thread to Zendesk FIN-2499 and include internal approval notes.

emma_finance: Approved on condition of signed PO addendum + attachments. Lex, hold until docs are present.

lex_billing: Understood. Will queue credit and wait for FIN-2499 to be completed.

support_agent: I'll send the customer logs and a concise explanation once the credit posts.

emma_finance: Tagging @raj_sales @marta_revops @lex_billing. Marking pending artifacts. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
